raid_colossus.name: 강철 거신
raid_colossus.subject: A colossal ancient iron titan golem covered in thick riveted steel armor plates, glowing molten-orange seams between plates, a massive anvil-like hammer fist, small glowing eyes in a fortress-like helmet head. Reads as nearly impenetrable armor. Raid boss: the largest, most imposing silhouette in the game, heavily detailed. Attack windup rears back and gathers strength; attack contact strikes forward hard with a clearly different pose; death lies collapsed flat. Keep breath, beams, wings and weapons short and inside the cell. Distinct from the style reference subject.
